entities.title: Database migrations
entities.summary: The SQL files through which the live samosa-scores database changes, numbered from 0002.
entities.purpose: worker/schema.sql describes a fresh database and was applied once; every later change to the live database is a file here, applied by hand before its pull request is merged, and made in schema.sql too so that a fresh database ends up the same.
boundaries: Applied by hand with wrangler, never by the deploy; the Database migration check and the deploy gate refuse a change here nobody has acknowledged (docs/database-migrations.md).
A file that has been applied is never edited or run again.
